Jean-Jacques Laffont "Competition, Information, and Development"

Besley and Burgess "Can Labor Regulation Hinder Economic Performance"

La Porta "Law and Finance" This last paper is AWESOME. It was the first of its kind, in terms of topic and methodology. Very interesting read if you are interested in how laws and regulations effect financial markets.
